说明: 英语作文背诵网页的内容（考研英语二）。改这个文件就行，改完运行 python3 data/zuowen/check.py 检查。id 一旦发布就不要改，背诵进度靠它对上。格式见 data/zuowen/README.md。

parts.name: 小作文
parts.desc: 10 分 · 约 100 词 · 书信 / 通知

parts.name: 大作文
parts.desc: 15 分 · 约 150 词 · 图表作文

scenes.name: 书信框架
scenes.note: 称呼 → 第一句说目的 → 正文（任务1、任务2）→ 结尾 → 落款。朋友用友好语气，教授、机构用正式语气。不写自己的名字，用 Li Ming；不写地址。

scenes.name: 时间地点
scenes.note: at + 钟点（at 3 p.m.）；on + 星期 / 日期（on Sunday, on May 1st）；in + 月 / 年 / 上下午（in May, in the morning）；next Friday、this weekend、tomorrow 前面不加介词。

scenes.name: 介绍细节
scenes.note: 最常考（17 年里有 10 年）。先总后分：时间地点 → 内容 → 安排 → 要求。每句话都要有动词。

scenes.name: 邀请参加
scenes.note: 邀请四件套：邀请 + 理由 + 怎么参加 + 期待回复。招募志愿者也算这一类，2015 年考的是通知（notice），格式看「通知模板」。

scenes.name: 建议理由
scenes.note: 建议要明确，理由要和建议对得上。advice 不可数；suggest 后面不接 sb. to do。

scenes.name: 请求与语气
scenes.note: 感谢、道歉、祝贺、投诉、谈感受：第一句就完成这个动作。道歉要说原因，感谢要说具体为什么。

scenes.name: 图表 · 占比
scenes.note: 只有一个时间点 → 静态：写占比、排第几、差距，不写「增长」。各项加起来不是 100% 时可能是多选，不能说「合计」。

scenes.name: 变化 · 趋势
scenes.note: 多个年份 → 动态：写方向、起点终点、最高点或转折点，不逐年报数。过去的数据用过去时。

scenes.name: 原因 · 意义
scenes.note: 原因写两点，用 may / maybe / one possible reason——看图证明不了的原因不能写成事实。不写原因时可以写意义：This shows that …

scenes.name: 建议 · 结论
scenes.note: 一两句收尾：先表态，再给一条建议或预测。建议要回扣图表，不写和图无关的套话。

scenes.name: 连接词
scenes.note: 连接词让文章有条理。记不住高级的，就用 first / also / but / so，一样清楚。

scenes.name: 升级替换
scenes.note: 左边是升级写法，「记不住就用」是保底写法。会写升级的就用，拿不准就用保底的——简单词写对不扣分，难词拼错才扣分。

guide.title: 考试要求
lines: 小作文：10 分，约 100 词，书信、邮件或通知，每题两个编号任务。不写自己的名字，用 Li Ming；不写地址。建议 15–20 分钟。
大作文：15 分，约 150 词，看图表 → 描述 → 解释原因或意义 → 评论或建议。建议约 30 分钟。
得分关键（按重要性）：任务完整 → 句子正确 → 格式语气合适 → 结构清楚 → 表达丰富。

guide.title: 小作文 · 审题五问
lines: 我是谁？（学生、志愿者、组织者……）
写给谁？（朋友 → 友好；教授、公司、机构 → 正式）
为什么写？（邀请、建议、道歉……）
任务1 要做什么？里面有几个动作？
任务2 要做什么？里面有几个动作？——写完对照任务逐项打勾，最常见的失分是漏掉第二个动作。

guide.title: 小作文 · 高频易错
lines: 每句话都要有动词：It is very long.（不能写 It very long.）
will be held（不是 will be hold）
take part in / participate in（in 不能漏）；invite sb. to do（to 不能漏）
look forward to + doing；suggest 后面不接 sb. to do；advice 不可数
the number of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 is
人名、地名、星期、月份首字母大写

guide.title: 大作文 · 读图五问
lines: 图在讲什么、讲谁？（看标题）
单位是什么？（%、人数、万辆……）
一个时间点还是多个？（一个 → 静态写占比；多个 → 动态写变化）
最大、最小、差距最大的是哪个？
各项加起来是 100% 吗？（不是 → 可能是多选，不能说「合计」）

guide.title: 大作文 · 常见硬伤
lines: 静态图写成「增长」；看错单位；把一部分和总数相加。
两个百分比相减要说百分点（percentage points）。
看图证明不了的原因写成事实——用 may / maybe / one possible reason。
只描述没评论，或者评论和图无关。

guide.title: 记不住单词怎么办
lines: 换简单的近义词：significant → important，purchase → buy。
用短语解释：volunteer 想不起来 → people who help for free。
换句子结构：be held 想不起来 → There will be … / The party is on …
实在不会就换个意思写，绝不硬写拼不出来的词。简单词写对不扣分，难词拼错才扣分。

guide.title: 写完检查
lines: 两个任务都写了吗？每个任务里的动作都做了吗？
称呼、结尾、落款和收信人语气对得上吗？
图表：对象、数字、单位和图一致吗？静态图有没有误写「增长」？过去的数据用了过去时吗？
三段齐全吗？有评论吗？原因有没有写成确定的事实？
逐句查：有没有动词、主谓一致、单复数、拼写、介词。字数：小作文约 100，大作文约 150。

words.zh: （信的称呼）尊敬的先生 / 女士
words.ex: 写给公司、机构、编辑，不知道对方名字时用
words.tip: Sir、Madam 首字母大写，后面加逗号

words.ex: Yours sincerely, 下一行写 Li Ming
words.tip: 写给教授、机构用它；写给朋友用 Best wishes,

words.ex: Best wishes, 下一行写 Li Ming
words.tip: 朋友、同学、留学生都用它

words.ex: I am looking forward to your reply.
words.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing，不接动词原形

words.ex: Please reply to me before Friday.
words.tip: 回复某人 reply to sb.；名词：your reply

words.ex: Please contact me at 13800000000.
words.tip: contact 后面直接跟人，不加 with

words.ex: Please reply at your earliest convenience.
The festival will be held next Saturday.
words.tip: hold 的过去分词是 held，不写 will be hold

words.ex: The venue is the school hall.
words.tip: venue 专指举办活动的场地

words.ex: Here is the schedule for the trip.
The trip will last two days.

words.ans: be located in|is located in|located in
words.ex: The museum is located in the city center.
There are many activities on campus.
All the tickets are free of charge.
There will be many activities.
a food festival / the Spring Festival
a speech competition
a lecture on Chinese history
a photo exhibition
The trip includes a visit to the Palace Museum.
We will provide free lunch.
words.tip: provide sb. with sth. / provide sth. for sb.

words.ex: traditional Chinese music
Chinese culture / cultural activities
words.tip: 名词 culture，形容词 cultural，别混用

words.ex: You can experience Chinese culture there.

words.ans: be famous for|is famous for|famous for
words.altAns: be well known for|is well known for|well known for|be well-known for|well-known for
words.ex: The city is famous for its long history.
words.tip: famous for + 原因；famous as + 身份

words.ex: There will be many kinds of delicious food.
words.tip: 拼写：de-li-cious；food 一般不加 s

words.ex: It is convenient to get there by subway.
words.tip: 说 It is convenient to do，不说 I am convenient

words.ex: Please wear comfortable shoes.
The scenery there is beautiful.
a city with a long history / historical sites
We will arrange accommodation for you.
I will make arrangements for your visit.
For more details, please contact me.
Please remember to bring your student card.
words.tip: 带来 bring，带走 take；过去式 brought

words.ex: I'd like to invite you to join our club.
words.tip: invite sb. to do，to 不能漏

words.ex: Thank you for your invitation.
I hope you can participate in the activity.
Would you like to attend the lecture?
words.tip: attend 后面直接接会议，不加 to

words.ans: be welcome to|are welcome to|welcome to
words.ex: You are welcome to join us.
words.tip: 不说 Welcome you to join us.

words.ex: It is a good opportunity to make friends.
I'm sure it will be an enjoyable experience.
We need ten volunteers.
The only requirement is good spoken English.
Volunteers should be fluent in English.
The deadline is October 20th.
Here is some advice for you.
words.tip: some advice / a piece of advice；不写 advices、an advice

words.ex: I suggest that you (should) join a club.
words.tip: suggest that sb. (should) do / suggest doing；不能写 suggest sb. to do

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.tip: 一个 c 两个 m：re-com-mend

words.ex: You had better leave early.

words.altAns: be careful about|be careful with|be careful
words.ex: Pay attention to your health.
words.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing

words.ex: Try to avoid going out alone at night.
Reading more can improve your English.
It takes time to adapt to college life.
balance study and rest
Get up early so that you can catch the bus.
I would appreciate it if you could help me.
words.tip: appreciate 后面接事，不接人，不加 for

words.ans: be grateful for|am grateful for|grateful for
words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
I apologize for missing the meeting.
words.tip: apologize for doing；英式拼写 apologise 也对

words.ex: I am sorry for the inconvenience.
I want to congratulate you on winning the prize.
words.tip: 介词用 on；名词复数 congratulations

words.ex: What is your opinion on my plan?

words.ans: be satisfied with|am satisfied with|satisfied with
words.altAns: be happy with|am happy with|happy with
words.ex: I am not satisfied with the service.
I hope you can solve the problem soon.
I would like a full refund.

words.ans: be impressed by|was impressed by|impressed by|be impressed with|impressed with
words.ex: I was deeply impressed by the video.
I wonder if you could give me some advice.
Thank you for your understanding.
The chart shows the results of a survey.

words.zh: 柱状图 / 饼图 / 折线图
words.en: bar chart / pie chart / line chart
words.ans: bar chart; pie chart; line chart
words.ex: The pie chart shows ...
According to the survey, ...
60% of the respondents chose reading.
The percentage of students who exercise is 40%.
A large proportion of people chose online shopping.
Studying accounts for 35%.
words.tip: 主语是单数要写 accounts for；它还有「解释原因」的意思

words.altAns: be the largest|is the largest|the largest|be the most popular|is the most popular|the most popular
words.ex: Reading ranks first with 45%.
Sports ranks first, followed by reading.
Men account for 60%, while women account for 40%.
Compared with boys, girls spend more time reading.
The number of A is twice that of B.
A is 15 percentage points higher than B.
words.tip: 两个百分比相减，差用 percentage points，不用 %

words.zh: 将近 / 大约 / 超过
words.ex: nearly half of the students / over 50%
The majority of students prefer shopping online.
The figure rose to 40%.
words.tip: 图表作文里 figure 是「数字」

words.ex: The number rose from 20 to 45.
words.tip: rise – rose – risen；increase 也能作名词：an increase in …

words.ex: The number dropped to 10%.
words.tip: drop – dropped（双写 p）；fall – fell – fallen

words.ex: The figure remained stable at about 30%.

words.altAns: reach the highest point|reached the highest point
words.ex: It reached a peak of 80% in 2020.
words.tip: reach a peak of + 数字

words.ans: reach its lowest point|reached its lowest point|reach the lowest point|reached the lowest point|hit its lowest point
words.altAns: drop to the lowest point|dropped to the lowest point
words.ex: It reached its lowest point in 2018.
The price fluctuated between 10 and 15 yuan.
The number rose sharply.
The number increased steadily.
The number dropped slightly.

words.altAns: become twice as large|became twice as large|twice
words.ex: The number of cars doubled in five years.
an upward trend / a downward trend
words.tip: 上升趋势 upward，下降趋势 downward

words.ex: In contrast, B dropped during the same period.
In contrast, the number of petrol cars dropped.
A and B rose to 30% and 40% respectively.
Several factors may account for this.
Due to the development of the Internet, shopping is easier.
words.tip: 后面接名词；接句子用 because

words.ans: lead to|result in|leads to|results in|led to|resulted in
words.ex: This may lead to health problems.
with the development of technology
words.tip: 拼写：de-vel-op-ment，p 后面没有 e

words.ex: with the improvement of living standards

words.ans: be aware of|are aware of|aware of|realize|realise
words.ex: More people are aware of the importance of health.
the importance of exercise

words.ans: pay more attention to|pay attention to
words.ex: People pay more attention to their health.
The government should take measures.
the government's policy support
Students face great pressure from exams.
protect the environment / environmental protection
be good for our health / a healthy lifestyle
People's income has increased.
Several factors may account for this phenomenon.
In conclusion, this trend is good for society.
In my opinion, this trend is worth our attention.
The government should take measures to solve the problem.
Schools should encourage students to exercise more.
It is necessary for us to protect the environment.
words.tip: 一个 c 两个 s：ne-ces-sa-ry

words.ex: This trend will continue in the future.
Students value study and health.
be good for society
Both the government and individuals should make efforts.
We should make efforts to protect the environment.

words.zh: 首先 / 其次 / 最后
words.ex: First, … Second, … Finally, …
Besides, the Internet offers many kinds of entertainment.
However, they should also balance work and rest.
words.tip: however 放句首，后面加逗号

words.ex: Therefore, we should take action now.

words.zh: 例如（接句子 / 接名词）
words.ex: for example 接句子；such as 接名词：such as singing and dancing
words.tip: 记不住 such as，接名词时可以用 like

words.ex: Meanwhile, the number of petrol cars dropped.
Obviously, more people like shopping online.
Although it is far, it is worth visiting.
words.tip: although 和 but 不能在一句里同时用

words.ex: Exercise plays a vital role in keeping healthy.

words.ans: a large number of|a great number of
words.ex: A large number of students choose to study.
words.tip: a large number of + 可数名词复数

words.ans: an increasing number of|a growing number of
words.ex: An increasing number of people shop online.
The chart indicates that more people exercise.
I believe this trend will continue.
Exercise is beneficial to our health.
Staying up late is harmful to our health.
The activity will benefit you a lot.
Students can gain experience from part-time jobs.
More people purchase goods online.
It is extremely important.
The Internet has an enormous influence on our lives.

patterns.zh: 我写信是想邀请你参加……
patterns.up: I am writing to invite you to ...
patterns.base: I want to invite you to ...
patterns.tip: I am writing to 后面接动词原形

patterns.zh: 我写信是想就……给你一些建议。
patterns.up: I am writing to give you some advice on ...
patterns.base: I want to give you some advice.
patterns.tip: advice 不可数：some advice，不写 advices

patterns.zh: 我写信是想告诉你……的情况。
patterns.up: I am writing to inform you of ...
patterns.base: I am writing to tell you about ...
patterns.tip: inform sb. of sth.

patterns.zh: 我写信是为……向你道歉。
patterns.up: I am writing to apologize for ...
patterns.base: I am writing to say sorry for ...
patterns.tip: for 后面接名词或 doing：apologize for missing the meeting

patterns.zh: 我写信是为……向你表示感谢。
patterns.up: I am writing to express my thanks for ...
patterns.base: I am writing to thank you for ...

patterns.zh: 我写信是为……向你表示祝贺。
patterns.up: I am writing to congratulate you on ...
patterns.base: Congratulations on ...!
patterns.tip: 介词用 on，不用 for

patterns.zh: 我写信是想请你在……方面帮帮我。
patterns.up: I am writing to ask for your help with ...
patterns.base: Could you please help me with ...?

patterns.zh: 我写信是想投诉……
patterns.up: I am writing to complain about ...
patterns.base: I am not happy with ...

patterns.zh: 我写信是想接受你的邀请，参加……
patterns.up: I am writing to accept your invitation to ...
patterns.base: I am glad to accept your invitation.

patterns.zh: 期待你的回复。
patterns.up: I am looking forward to your reply.
patterns.base: I hope to hear from you soon.
patterns.tip: look forward to 后面接名词或 doing

patterns.use: 结尾 · 有问题联系我
patterns.zh: 如果有任何问题，请随时联系我。
patterns.up: Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
patterns.base: Please let me know if you have any questions.

patterns.zh: 感谢你抽出时间（读这封信）。
patterns.up: Thank you for your time and consideration.
patterns.base: Thank you for your time.
patterns.tip: 写给教授、机构时常用

patterns.zh: 活动下午三点开始。
patterns.up: The activity will start at 3 p.m.
patterns.base: The activity starts at 3 p.m.
patterns.tip: at + 钟点：at 9:30 a.m.

patterns.zh: 讲座将于 5 月 20 日（星期五）举行。
patterns.up: The lecture will be held on Friday, May 20th.
patterns.base: The lecture is on Friday, May 20th.
patterns.tip: on + 星期 / 具体日期；on Sunday morning 也用 on

patterns.zh: 我们打算七月去旅行。
patterns.up: We plan to go on a trip in July.
patterns.base: We will travel in July.
patterns.tip: in + 月 / 年 / in the morning；next Friday、this weekend 前面不加介词

patterns.zh: 活动从上午九点持续到下午五点。
patterns.up: The event will last from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
patterns.base: The event is from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.

patterns.zh: 比赛将在学校礼堂举行。
patterns.up: The competition will take place in the school hall.
patterns.base: The competition is in the school hall.
patterns.tip: in the hall / in Room 302 / on the playground / at the school gate

patterns.zh: 我会早上八点在学校门口等你。
patterns.up: I will meet you at the school gate at 8 a.m.
patterns.base: I will wait for you at the school gate at 8 a.m.
patterns.tip: wait for sb.，for 不能漏

patterns.zh: 文化节将于本周日下午三点在操场举行。
patterns.up: The culture festival will be held at 3 p.m. this Sunday on the playground.
patterns.base: The culture festival is at 3 p.m. this Sunday on the playground.
patterns.tip: this Sunday 前面不加 on

patterns.zh: 将会有各种各样的活动，比如唱歌、跳舞和游戏。
patterns.up: There will be various activities, such as singing, dancing and games.
patterns.base: There will be many activities, like singing and games.

patterns.zh: 首先我们参观博物馆，然后吃午饭，最后去购物。
patterns.up: First, we will visit the museum. Then, we will have lunch. Finally, we will go shopping.
patterns.base: We will visit the museum first. Then we will have lunch and go shopping.

patterns.zh: 它以悠久的历史和美丽的风景而闻名。
patterns.up: It is famous for its long history and beautiful scenery.
patterns.base: It is very old and beautiful, so many people like it.

patterns.zh: 请记得带上你的学生证。
patterns.up: Please remember to bring your student card.
patterns.base: You need to bring your student card.

patterns.zh: 所有活动都是免费的。
patterns.up: All the activities are free of charge.
patterns.base: All the activities are free.

patterns.zh: 想了解更多详情，请随时给我发邮件。
patterns.up: For more details, please feel free to email me.
patterns.base: If you want to know more, please email me.

patterns.zh: 我想邀请你参加这次活动。
patterns.up: I'd like to invite you to take part in the activity.
patterns.base: Would you like to join the activity?
patterns.tip: I'd like = I would like，后面接 to do

patterns.zh: 这是了解中国文化的好机会。
patterns.up: It is a good opportunity to learn about Chinese culture.
patterns.base: It is a good chance to learn about China.

patterns.zh: 我相信你一定会喜欢的。
patterns.up: I am sure you will enjoy it.
patterns.base: I think you will like it.

patterns.zh: 如果你感兴趣，请在周五之前回复我。
patterns.up: If you are interested, please reply to me before Friday.
patterns.base: If you want to come, please tell me before Friday.

patterns.zh: 非常欢迎你加入我们。
patterns.up: You are warmly welcome to join us.
patterns.base: You are welcome to join us.

patterns.zh: 我很高兴接受你的邀请。
patterns.up: I am delighted to accept your invitation.
patterns.base: I am glad to accept your invitation.

patterns.zh: 我们正在招募十名志愿者帮助外国学生。
patterns.up: We are looking for ten volunteers to help international students.
patterns.base: We need ten volunteers to help foreign students.

patterns.zh: 志愿者应该英语流利，乐于助人。
patterns.up: Volunteers should be fluent in English and willing to help others.
patterns.base: Volunteers should speak good English and like helping others.

patterns.zh: 这里有一些建议给你。
patterns.up: Here are some suggestions for you.
patterns.base: Here is some advice for you.
patterns.tip: advice 不可数用 is；suggestions 可数用 are

patterns.zh: 我建议你多参加社团活动。
patterns.up: I suggest that you (should) take part in more club activities.
patterns.base: You should join more clubs.
patterns.tip: suggest that sb. (should) + 动词原形

patterns.zh: 提前订票是个好主意。
patterns.up: It would be a good idea to book the tickets in advance.
patterns.base: You should book the tickets early.

patterns.zh: 这能帮你交新朋友，提高英语。
patterns.up: This can help you make new friends and improve your English.
patterns.base: It is good for you, because you can make new friends.
patterns.tip: help sb. do sth.

patterns.zh: 首先，你应该……；其次，……也是个好主意。
patterns.up: First, you should ... Second, it is also a good idea to ...
patterns.base: First, you should ... Also, you can ...

patterns.zh: 希望我的建议对你有帮助。
patterns.up: I hope my advice will be helpful to you.
patterns.base: I hope my advice can help you.

patterns.zh: 如果你能给我一些建议，我将不胜感激。
patterns.up: I would appreciate it if you could give me some advice.
patterns.base: Could you please give me some advice?

patterns.zh: 不知道我们能否改到下周一见面。
patterns.up: I wonder if we could meet next Monday instead.
patterns.base: Can we meet next Monday?

patterns.zh: 你觉得我的计划怎么样？
patterns.up: What is your opinion on my plan?
patterns.base: What do you think of my plan?

patterns.zh: 非常抱歉我不能参加会议，因为我得照顾生病的妈妈。
patterns.up: I am terribly sorry that I cannot attend the meeting, because I have to look after my sick mother.
patterns.base: I am sorry I cannot come to the meeting. My mother is ill.
patterns.tip: 道歉一定要说原因

patterns.zh: 非常感谢你在我生病时照顾我。
patterns.up: Thank you very much for taking care of me when I was ill.
patterns.base: Thanks a lot for your help when I was ill.
patterns.tip: 感谢要说清楚为什么

patterns.zh: 祝贺你考上了理想的大学！
patterns.up: Congratulations on being admitted to your dream university!
patterns.base: Congratulations on getting into a good university!

patterns.zh: 我对这项服务很不满意，希望你们尽快解决这个问题。
patterns.up: I am not satisfied with the service, and I hope you can solve the problem as soon as possible.
patterns.base: I am not happy with the service. Please fix the problem soon.

patterns.zh: 这段视频给我留下了深刻的印象。
patterns.up: I was deeply impressed by the video.
patterns.base: I really liked the video.

patterns.zh: 我希望进一步了解这座城市。
patterns.up: I hope to learn more about the city.
patterns.base: I want to know more about the city.

patterns.zh: 如图所示，……
patterns.up: As is shown in the chart, ...
patterns.base: The chart shows ...
patterns.tip: 也可以写 As shown in the chart

patterns.zh: 这张饼图展示了一项关于大学生如何过周末的调查结果。
patterns.up: The pie chart shows the results of a survey on how college students spend their weekends.
patterns.base: The pie chart is about how college students spend their weekends.

patterns.zh: 学习排第一，占 35%，其次是运动，占 25%。
patterns.up: Studying ranks first, accounting for 35%, followed by sports at 25%.
patterns.base: Studying is the largest part (35%), and doing sports is the second (25%).

patterns.zh: 上网娱乐占 20%，而 12% 的学生做兼职。
patterns.up: Surfing the Internet makes up 20%, while 12% of the students do part-time jobs.
patterns.base: 20% of the students surf the Internet, and 12% do part-time jobs.

patterns.zh: 只有 8% 的人选择其他活动。
patterns.up: Only 8% of the people choose other activities.
patterns.base: Only 8% choose other things.

patterns.zh: A 的比例比 B 高 15 个百分点。
patterns.up: The percentage of A is 15 percentage points higher than that of B.
patterns.base: A is much higher than B.
patterns.tip: 两个百分比的差是百分点

patterns.zh: 选择 A 的人数是选择 B 的两倍。
patterns.up: The number of people choosing A is twice that of B.
patterns.base: A is 40%, while B is only 20%.
patterns.tip: 记不住倍数句，直接报两个数也行

patterns.zh: 大多数受访者更喜欢网上购物。
patterns.up: The majority of the respondents prefer shopping online.
patterns.base: Most people like shopping online.

patterns.zh: 总之，学习和运动是两项最主要的周末活动。
patterns.up: In short, studying and sports are the two most popular weekend activities.
patterns.base: We can see that most students study or do sports on weekends.

patterns.zh: 电动汽车的数量从 2015 年的 2 万辆急剧上升到 2025 年的 45 万辆。
patterns.up: The number of electric cars increased sharply from 20,000 in 2015 to 450,000 in 2025.
patterns.base: The number of electric cars went up a lot from 20,000 to 450,000.
patterns.tip: the number of + 复数名词，谓语用单数；过去的数据用过去时

patterns.zh: 网购人数大幅增长。
patterns.up: There was a sharp increase in the number of online shoppers.
patterns.base: The number of online shoppers went up a lot.

patterns.zh: 它在 2020 年达到 80% 的峰值，随后略有下降。
patterns.up: It reached a peak of 80% in 2020 and then dropped slightly.
patterns.base: It was the highest in 2020 (80%), and then it went down a little.

patterns.zh: 同一时期，燃油车数量从 120 万辆逐渐减少到 100 万辆。
patterns.up: During the same period, the number of petrol cars decreased gradually from 1.2 million to 1 million.
patterns.base: At the same time, the number of petrol cars went down from 1.2 million to 1 million.

patterns.zh: 相比之下，农村的数字一直保持稳定。
patterns.up: In contrast, the figure in rural areas remained stable.
patterns.base: But the number in the countryside stayed the same.

patterns.zh: 显然，电动汽车越来越受欢迎。
patterns.up: Obviously, electric cars are becoming more and more popular.
patterns.base: We can see that more people like electric cars.

patterns.zh: 这一比例从 2010 年的 30% 上升到 2020 年的 50%。
patterns.up: The proportion rose from 30% in 2010 to 50% in 2020.
patterns.base: In 2010 it was 30%, while in 2020 it was 50%.

patterns.zh: 这一现象可能有几个原因。
patterns.up: Several factors may account for this phenomenon.
patterns.base: There may be several reasons for this.

patterns.zh: 首先，随着科技的发展，电动汽车变得更便宜了。
patterns.up: First, with the development of technology, electric cars have become cheaper.
patterns.base: First, technology is better now, so electric cars are cheaper.

patterns.zh: 一个可能的原因是学生面临巨大的考试压力。
patterns.up: One possible reason is that students face great pressure from exams.
patterns.base: Maybe students have a lot of pressure from exams.
patterns.tip: 看图不能证明的原因，用 may / maybe / one possible reason

patterns.zh: 其次，随着生活水平的提高，人们更加关注健康。
patterns.up: Second, with the improvement of living standards, people pay more attention to their health.
patterns.base: Second, people have more money now, so they care more about their health.

patterns.zh: 此外，政府鼓励人们绿色出行。
patterns.up: Besides, the government encourages people to choose green transport.
patterns.base: Also, the government asks people to travel in a green way.

patterns.zh: 这表明越来越多的人意识到了锻炼的重要性。
patterns.up: This shows that more and more people are aware of the importance of exercise.
patterns.base: This means that more people know exercise is important.

patterns.zh: 因此，人们的生活变得更加方便了。
patterns.up: As a result, people's lives have become more convenient.
patterns.base: So life is easier for people now.

patterns.zh: 总之，这一趋势对我们的环境有好处。
patterns.up: In conclusion, this trend is beneficial to our environment.
patterns.base: In short, this trend is good for our environment.

patterns.zh: 我们有必要平衡学习和休息。
patterns.up: It is necessary for us to balance study and rest.
patterns.base: We should balance study and rest.

patterns.zh: 政府应该采取有效措施解决这个问题。
patterns.up: The government should take effective measures to solve this problem.
patterns.base: The government should do something to solve this problem.

patterns.zh: 学校应该鼓励学生多参加户外活动。
patterns.up: Schools should encourage students to take part in more outdoor activities.
patterns.base: Schools should ask students to do more outdoor activities.

patterns.zh: 我相信将来会有更多人选择电动汽车。
patterns.up: I believe that more people will choose electric cars in the future.
patterns.base: I think more people will choose electric cars in the future.

patterns.zh: 政府和个人都应该努力解决这个问题。
patterns.up: Both the government and individuals should make efforts to solve this problem.
patterns.base: Everyone should work together to solve this problem.

templates.name: 书信通用模板
templates.when: 邀请、介绍、建议、感谢……大部分小作文都能套。花括号里的内容按题目写，用对应场景的句型。
paras: Dear {称呼：Jack / Professor Smith / Sir or Madam},
I am writing to {写信目的：invite you to … / give you some advice on …}. {任务1：两三句，写清时间、地点、内容或建议}.
Besides, {任务2：两三句}. I hope {一句愿望：you can join us / my advice will be helpful to you}.
Please let me know if you have any questions. I am looking forward to your reply.

templates.name: 通知模板
templates.when: 题目要求写 notice（通知）时用：标题居中，正文不写 Dear，右下角写发布者。
paras: In order to {目的：enrich students' campus life}, {组织者：the Students' Union} will hold {活动名称：a summer camp} {时间：from July 10th to 20th} {地点：on our campus}.
{活动内容：两三句，There will be … / Participants can …}.
Anyone who is interested is welcome to take part. Please sign up {报名方式和截止时间：by emailing … before …}.

templates.name: 静态图模板（饼图 / 柱状图）
templates.when: 图里只有一个时间点：写占比、排第几、差距。
paras: The {图表类型：pie chart / bar chart} shows {图表主题：how college students spend their weekends}. {最大项} ranks first, accounting for {数字}%, followed by {第二项} at {数字}%. {第三项} makes up {数字}%, while only {数字}% {最小项}. In short, {一句概括}.
Several factors may account for this phenomenon. First, {原因一}. Second, {原因二}. Besides, {原因三，可省}.
In my opinion, {表态：it is good that …}. Therefore, {建议：we should … / schools should …}. I believe that {预测} in the future.

templates.name: 动态图模板（折线图 / 多年份）
templates.when: 图里有多个年份：写变化方向、起点终点、对比。
paras: The {图表类型：line chart / bar chart} shows the changes in {对象} from {起始年} to {结束年}. The number of {对象A} increased {sharply / steadily} from {起点数据} in {年份} to {终点数据} in {年份}. In contrast, {对象B} {dropped / remained stable} during the same period. Obviously, {一句概括趋势}.
Several reasons may explain this trend. First, with the development of {科技 / 经济 / 互联网}, {原因一}. Second, {原因二}. In addition, {原因三，可省}.
In conclusion, this trend is {beneficial / harmful} to {对象：our society / the environment}. I believe that {预测} in the future, and {谁：the government / we} should {建议}.

essays.name: 介绍 + 邀请（写给朋友）
essays.prompt: 你校下周六举办文化节。给留学生朋友 Jack 写一封信：1）介绍活动；2）邀请他参加。约 100 词。
paras: I am writing to invite you to the Culture Festival at our university.
The festival will be held from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. next Saturday on the main playground.
There will be many activities, such as paper cutting, Chinese calligraphy and traditional music performances.
You can also try some local food for free.
I am sure you will enjoy it, because it is a good chance to learn about Chinese culture and make new friends.
If you would like to come, please reply to me before Thursday, and I will meet you at the school gate at 8:45 a.m.
I am looking forward to your reply.

essays.name: 道歉 + 改期（写给教授）
essays.prompt: 你本周五下午 3 点约了 Smith 教授见面，但去不了。写一封邮件：1）道歉并说明原因；2）建议改约时间。约 100 词。
paras: I am writing to say sorry that I cannot meet you at 3 p.m. this Friday as planned.
My grandmother is ill in hospital, and I have to go home to look after her this weekend.
I wonder if we could meet next Monday or Tuesday afternoon instead.
I am free after 2 p.m. on both days, and I can come to your office at any time that is convenient for you.
If you prefer, we can also talk online.
I am very sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your understanding.
I am looking forward to your reply.

essays.name: 静态图（饼图）
essays.prompt: 某大学学生周末活动调查：学习 35%，运动 25%，上网娱乐 20%，兼职 12%，其他 8%。描述图表，分析原因，给出评论。约 150 词。
paras: The pie chart shows how college students spend their weekends, based on a survey at a university.
Studying ranks first, accounting for 35%, followed by sports at 25%.
Surfing the Internet for fun makes up 20%, while 12% of the students do part-time jobs.
In short, studying and sports are the two main weekend activities.
Several factors may account for this.
First, many students face great pressure from exams and job hunting, so they use weekends to study.
Second, more and more young people realize that exercise is good for their health.
Besides, the Internet offers many kinds of entertainment, which attracts some students.
In my opinion, it is good that students value study and health.
However, they should also balance work and rest.
Universities can organize more weekend activities to help them relax.

essays.name: 动态图（折线图）
essays.prompt: 某市 2015–2025 年汽车数量：电动汽车从 2 万辆增至 45 万辆；燃油车从 120 万辆降至 100 万辆。描述图表，分析原因，给出评论。约 150 词。
paras: The line chart shows the changes in the number of electric cars and petrol cars in a city from 2015 to 2025.
The number of electric cars increased sharply from 20,000 in 2015 to 450,000 in 2025.
In contrast, the number of petrol cars dropped gradually from 1.2 million to 1 million during the same period.
Obviously, electric cars are becoming more and more popular.
Several reasons may explain this trend.
First, with the development of technology, electric cars have become cheaper and more convenient to use.
Second, the government supports green transport, for example, by building more charging stations.
In addition, people care more about the environment than before.
In conclusion, this trend is good for our environment.
I believe more people will choose electric cars in the future, and the government should continue to build more charging stations.

gpt: 【说明】
下面是我的考研英语（二）写作资料：总路线 + 讲义（词汇、句型、模板、例文）。我在一个背诵网页上背这些内容。请你当我的写作老师，按总路线带我练习，怎么教、节奏快慢由你根据我的表现决定。几点希望：
- 先让我自己写，再帮我改；改的时候优先改我自己的句子。
- 我写不出某个词时，教我用简单词替换（讲义里「记不住就用」那一列）。
- 可以用历年真题，也可以按真题风格自己出题。
- 每次练习结束，给我一张「进度卡」，我换新对话时贴给你，接着练。
【总路线】
一、我的情况
- 考研英语（二），考试时间约 2026 年 12 月下旬。作文基础差，词汇量少。
- 已经暴露的问题：小作文漏掉第二个任务；句子缺动词（the Great Wall very long）；建议句要提示才写得出；at / on / in 混用；will be hold；participate 漏 in；culture / cultural 混用。
- 策略：宁可简单也要写对。不会的词用简单词替换，不追求高级表达。
二、阶段路线（每阶段：学词 → 学句型 → 写句子 → 写段落或整篇 → 过关）
小作文：A1 审题（列全身份、收信人、两个任务及其中的动作）→ A2 书信框架（三种收信人的开头结尾都写对）→ A3 介绍细节（介词、被动、单复数基本无错）→ A4 邀请（邀请 + 理由 + 怎么参加 + 期待回复）→ A5 建议 + 理由 → A6 请求与语气（感谢、道歉、祝贺、投诉、谈感受）→ A7 限时整篇（15–20 分钟，100 词）。
大作文：B1 读图（对象、单位、时间、类别，挑 2–3 个关键数据）→ B2 事实句（静态写占比，动态写变化）→ B3 三段成文（描述 → 原因或意义 → 建议或结论，不编数据）→ B4 限时整篇（约 30 分钟，150 词）。
顺序建议：先做 A1、A2，然后小作文和大作文交替推进。
三、真题风格参考

小作文 2010–2026：2010 感谢接待 + 欢迎来访｜2011 祝贺 + 大学生活建议｜2012 投诉 + 要求解决｜2013 告知慈善义卖细节 + 鼓励参加｜2014 介绍生活习惯 + 征求建议｜2015 通知：介绍夏令营 + 招募志愿者｜2016 感谢 + 翻译建议｜2017 接受邀请 + 介绍演讲要点｜2018 道歉解释 + 建议改期｜2019 建议辩题 + 理由和安排｜2020 介绍景点 + 旅游提示｜2021 邀请参加线上会议 + 告知细节｜2022 介绍美食节 + 邀请｜2023 二选一活动建议 + 理由｜2024 提出调查计划 + 征求意见｜2025 介绍短剧 + 邀请参演｜2026 谈对旅行视频的感受 + 希望进一步了解。

大作文 2010–2026：动态（2010 手机用户、2014 城乡人口、2017 博物馆数量与参观人次、2022 快递量、2023 健康素养）；两个时间点对比（2011 汽车品牌份额、2019 毕业生去向）；饼图（2015 春节花销、2016 旅游目的、2020 手机阅读目的）；类别比较（2013 不同年级兼职、2018 选餐厅因素、2021 锻炼方式、2024 劳动课收获、2025 老年人休闲活动、2026 儿童户外活动看法）；表格（2012 年龄与工作满意度）。话题每年不同，不用背话题，背描述数据和写评论的通用表达。
四、进度卡格式（每次练习结束输出）
【进度卡】当前阶段： / 已过关： / 本次练习（题目、得分参考、主要问题）： / 反复出现的错误： / 已学会的词和句型： / 下一步：
